summary: CR-011-ROOM Room Orders page testing complete. All core features working correctly with Welcome Resort login. Page loads at /reports-module/room-orders, KPI pills show room-only revenue (not lodging+food combined), date presets work, tabs filter correctly, room rows load with per-row detail, expanding rows shows Room Billing + Associated Orders, charts render after data resolves, summary bar shows full folio totals, download button shows Excel/PDF options, empty state shown for Cafe103 (no rooms).

Per-row detail fetches lazily via getSingleOrderRoom - charts and KPIs progressively update as details resolve
Summary bar correctly shows full folio totals (not room-only) for operational view
Tab labels use 'Settled' for fOrderStatus=6 and 'In-House / Unpaid' for fOrderStatus!=6 as specified
